Welcome

How can faculty help Europe compete, innovate and prosper?

From productivity and industrial innovation to talent and responsible AI, INSEAD faculty bring evidence to questions shaping France and the EU.

Inspire Europe brings together their research, ideas and conversations in one curated place, rooted in the Europe Campus at Fontainebleau.

How faculty contribute

Faculty connect rigorous research with the business and policy choices that shape competitive markets.

Build the evidence

Research helps explain productivity, competition, labour markets, new technology and the conditions for growth.

Inform public dialogue

Articles, interviews, reports and events bring findings into conversation with business and policy leaders.

Equip leaders to act

Teaching and executive education help organisations apply research in strategy, AI and transformation.
